effectEntries.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

descriptions.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
Der Anwender greift mit seinem ganzen Körper an. Je höher seine Verteidigung ist, desto mehr Schaden richtet er an.
The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.

Le lanceur utilise son corps pour attaquer sa cible. Plus la Défense du lanceur est élevée, plus les dégâts infligés sont importants.
Chi la usa schiaccia il bersaglio con il suo corpo. Più la sua Difesa è alta, maggiori sono i danni inflitti.
体を ぶつけて 攻撃。 防御が 高いほど 与える ダメージが 増える。
からだを ぶつけて こうげき。 ぼうぎょが たかいほど あたえる ダメージが ふえる。
몸을 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 방어가 높을수록 주는 데미지가 올라간다.
用身体撞向对手进行攻击。 防御越高， 给予的伤害就越高。
用身體撞向對手進行攻擊。 自己的防禦越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。
